bias.zh: 看空 · 超卖反弹受制于 $176–178

read.en: Arm rose 4.7% on Nov 6 to $174.62, trading $169.61–177.62. It remains below the falling 5-day ($186.5), 10-day ($205.3), 30-day ($242.6) and 100-day ($272.1) and the rising 200-day ($230.8) averages. MACD has been below its signal since Oct 7, below zero, with the histogram still widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 30 ($225.80), and RSI is 31.
read.zh: Arm 11月6日上涨 4.7%，收于 $174.62，盘中区间 $169.61–177.62。股价仍位于下行的 5 日（$186.5）、10 日（$205.3）、30 日（$242.6）和 100 日均线（$272.1）以及上行的 200 日均线（$230.8）下方。MACD 自 10月7日起位于信号线下方，处于零轴下方，柱状图仍在扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 10月30日起看空（$225.80），RSI 为 31。

read.en: The bounce poked above the $175.83 Nov 5 high to $177.62 but closed just below it; the $163.1 support was not tested. Resistance is $175.8–177.6, then $183.2–186.5 (Oct 27, 2025 high, 5-day) and $189.9–191.8 (Nov 4 low and close). Support is $169.6 (Nov 6 low), then $163.1 and $158.4. A close above $177.6 would target $183–186.5; below $169.6, $163.
